prompt: Work autonomously and do not ask questions. Implement run-length encoding in src/lib.rs. `encode` turns each run of the same character into that character followed by the run length, omitting the length when it is 1, so `aaabcc` becomes `a3bc2`. `decode` reverses that, treats a missing count as 1, accepts multi-digit counts, and returns `None` when the input starts with a digit, has a zero count, or has trailing digits. Keep the public API and the existing tests unchanged. Run `cargo test` and finish only when the tests pass.
